_doc: PRE-REGISTERED cohort/method/pass-bar for the 2026-07-22 bull-gate requalification under CURRENT config (ATM strike + SS-B/RIBBON_RIDE exit shape). Frozen BEFORE any replay is run -- no re-picks after seeing results. Mission: J-directed MIRROR-PARITY AUDIT + BULL REQUALIFICATION (CLAUDE.md OP-16: 're-eval at n>=20 under SS-B + corrected strike tier' has never been run at ATM). This extends the existing block_elite_bull-ssb-revalidation.json (2026-07-10) study, which already applied SS-B exit shape but STILL used OTM-2 strikes (STRIKE_OFFSET_BULL=-2) -- the one variable this pre-reg corrects.
account_scope: safe (Gamma-Safe-2) ONLY. Bold has a different VIX band [15,18) and block_bull_morning_agg=false (J-directed removal 2026-06-24) -- out of scope, separate study if needed.
strategy: BULLISH_RECLAIM_RIDE_THE_RIBBON (ribbon_ride) -- the only bull setup in setups_allowed.

method.signal_detection: run_backtest(use_real_fills=True) A/B per gate, held-constant isolation: BASE = both prod gates True; UNBLOCK_ELITE = block_elite_bull False (block_bull_1100_1200 held True); UNBLOCK_1100 = block_bull_1100_1200 False (block_elite_bull held True). Added cohort per gate = trades present in the UNBLOCK run but not BASE, filtered side=='C'. This reuses bull_unblock_replay_probe.py's established added-cohort method (dated 2026-06-30), changing ONLY strike_offset (-2 -> 0) and the window/gate-stack to current production values.
method.strike: strike_offset=0 (ATM) -- corrects the one variable every prior bull-gate study (2026-06-18 original ratifications, 2026-06-30 replay, 2026-07-10 SS-B revalidation) left at OTM-2 or OTM-3. ATM has been core-Safe's REAL live strike since >=2026-06-18 per analysis/deep-research/2026-07-11-strike-tier-reconciliation.md.
method.window_rationale: Bounded by backtest/data/options/ cache coverage (earliest relevant continuous SPY 5m + option-bar overlap through 2026-07-17; task brief's own '2026-05-19..07-17+' framing). No live/broker reads used (rail-4/no-broker-imports compliance) -- entry premiums and exit walks are 100% local-cache (backtest/data/options/*.csv), so any signal whose contract is not cached is DROPPED and counted in n_missing_bars, never imputed.
method.exit_replay: backtest/lib/exit_manager_walk.py#walk_exit_manager -- the REAL production exit_manager.plan_exit_actions decision core (NOT simulate_trade_real, which exit_manager_walk.py's own docstring documents as KNOWN-DIVERGENT from live). exit_shape = automation/state/fleet/strategies.py RIBBON_RIDE.exit.to_dict() (the LIVE-SHIPPED SS-B shape: premium_stop_pct=-0.50 catastrophe cap, tp1_premium_pct=1.0/sell 66.7%, profit_lock_mode=trailing/trail_pct=0.15, runner_target_pct=99.0, stop_mode=structure). structure_stop_enabled=True (matches automation/state/params.json's live structure_stop_enabled=true). trigger_level = the added trade's own rejection_level from the run_backtest detection pass. time_stop_et = exit_manager.TIME_STOP_ET (15:50 ET, the live constant). opt_df/five_min_spy_df sourced from local backtest/data/ caches only.
method.known_simplification: ribbon_tick_df=None (no ribbon-flip-back exit modeled) -- matches the established methodology in backtest/tools/structure_stop_study.py#replay_structure_aware (which always passes ribbon_flip_back=False), the same simplification the already-shipped 2026-07-10 SS-B revalidation used. This is CONSERVATIVE for a bull cohort under scrutiny (an omitted early-exit channel can only remove a WORSE outcome from firing, i.e. this walk can only be flattering, never unfairly harsh, to the cohorts under test) -- disclosed, not hidden.

stats_reported_per_cohort: drop_top1 (remove single largest winner, remainder + sign)
chronological half-split (first half of window vs second half) as an IS/OOS-style stability proxy -- the 2-month window is too short for a calendar-quarter split
n_structure_fired (how many exits used the structure-stop channel vs premium/TP1/time-stop)

pass_bar_OP16.statement: Per CLAUDE.md OP-16 auto-ratify rail (adapted to a REQUALIFICATION, not a fresh ship): a gate is graded RETIRE (unblock recommended) only if ALL of:
conditions: 1. n >= 20 (the OP-16 evidence_n bar the task brief cites verbatim -- n<20 is RETEST-INSUFFICIENT-N, not a forced verdict either way)
3. both halves of the chronological split are not both negative (sub-window stability -- majority-of-days-or-halves stable, matching OP-22's SW_hurt<=1 spirit)
4. drop_top1 remainder still positive (survives dropping the single largest winner -- guards against one-trade concentration mirage)
pass_bar_OP16.any_condition_failing_with_n_ge_20: verdict = KEEP (the original block's verdict SURVIVES on current config)
pass_bar_OP16.n_below_20: verdict = RETEST-INSUFFICIENT-N regardless of sign -- never forced either way, per the task brief's explicit instruction.

too_good_discipline: If either gate's ATM/SS-B cohort clears the pass bar (verdict RETIRE) AND its total_pnl is more than 2x the magnitude of the corresponding OTM-2/SS-B or OLD-exit total on the SAME added-cohort trades, the output must name the specific artifact hunted (day-concentration, single-signal dominance, ATM-vs-OTM premium-scaling sanity check on 2-3 sample trades) before the verdict is reported -- per /fable-too-good.
